title.narrative: UNDP - Women's Participation in Community Conflict Prevention in BARMM

description.narrative: UNDP through the support of different partners, including the Bangsamoro Women Commission, has supported the establishment of the Women Insider Mediators – Rapid Action and Mobilization Platform (WIM-RAMP). WIM-RAMP is a group of community-based women mediators from Moro and Indigenous Peoples communities in the BARMM. Composed of members representing their own respective organizations, the WIM-RAMP agreed to work towards common goals and aspirations. Specifically, the WIM RAMP members, in partnership with the BWC, have committed to work together towards strengthening the role of women in building peaceful and resilient communities in the Bangsamoro. Among their areas of work include (1) implementation of humanitarian response initiatives in conflict areas; (2) Advocacies against Violence Against Women and Children, gender-based violence, and child, early and forced marriage; (3) Community-based mediation and early warning and response; and, (4) advocacy on prevention of violent extremism/promotion of peaceful engagement.
